2.013 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK RESTOW
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN013
Start_IMS
OBJECTIVE:
Dust and Aerosol measurement Feasibility Test (DAFT). This procedure disassembles and
stows the P-Trak and DustTrak. It completes the DAFT sample collection process.
STATION PARTS:
P-Trak-01 P/N DAFT-0101
DustTrak P/N DAFT-0201
DAFT Accessories Kit P/N DAFT-0700
P-Trak Batteries [6] P/N DAFT-0708
Used P-Trak Batteries P/N DAFT-0718
DustTrak Batteries [4] P/N DAFT-0709
Used DustTrak Batteries P/N DAFT-0719
Single Strap P/N PERS0041
Cable Straps [6] P/N 528-43074-1
STATION TOOLS:
4X4 Ziplock Bag [2] P/N 528-21039-2
Fine Point Sharpie P/N 528-40674-1
Bar Code Kit P/N 582-21046-3
1. P-TRAK DISASSEMBLY
1.1 Retrieve P-Trak-01.
1.2 √P-Trak-01 power − Off
P-Trak-01 1.3 Disconnect P-Trak Hose Adapter from P-Trak-01.
P-Trak Hose Adapter ←|→ Inlet
Tmpry stow P-Trak-01.
1.4 Retrieve DAFT Accessories Kit.
DAFT Accessories 1.5 Stow P-Trak Hose Adapter.
Kit
1.6 Tmpry stow DAFT Accessories Kit.
1.7 Retrieve P-Trak-01.
06May04 N013-1 DAFT/PB3-01-0677

2.013 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK RESTOW
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN013
P-Trak-01 1.8 √For Storage Only Cap is installed in P-Trak-01
* *******************************************************************
* If For Storage Only Cap is not installed,
* Perform {2.006 DAFT P-TRAK SETUP},
* steps 2.3 to 2.8, then:
* *******************************************************************
1.9 Remove and Tmpry stow P-Trak Battery Cover.
1.10 Remove P-Trak battery pack from P-Trak-01
(slight prying motion).
1.11 Remove P-Trak Batteries (six).
Tmpry stow P-Trak Batteries (six).
1.12 Replace P-Trak battery pack in P-Trak-01
(using the alignment mark or guide).
1.13 Retrieve and replace P-Trak Battery Cover.
1.14 Stow P-Trak-01.
1.15 If first P-Trak Batteries stowage,
Unstow:
4X4 Ziplock Bag (2)
Fine Point Sharpie
Bar Code Kit
Tmpry stow:
4X4 Ziplock Bag
Bar Code Kit
If not first P-Trak Batteries stowage,
Unstow Used P-Trak Batteries (P/N DAFT-0718).
Go to step 1.22.
1.16 Using Fine Point Sharpie, label 4X4 Ziplock Bag,
Used P-Trak Batteries P/N DAFT-0718.
Tmpry stow:
4X4 Ziplock Bag
Fine Point Sharpie
1.17 Retrieve Bar Code Kit.
Bar Code Kit 1.18 Remove IMS Bar Code Label.
Tmpry stow Bar Code Kit.
06May04 N013-2 DAFT/PB3-01-0677

2.013 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK RESTOW
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN013
1.19 Retrieve 4X4 Ziplock Bag.
1.20 Place IMS Bar Code Label on Used P-Trak Batteries.
1.21 Manually update IMS or Notify POIC with the new
DAFT B/C number (as required).
1.22 Retrieve P-Trak Batteries (six).
Place P-Trak Batteries (six) in Used P-Trak Batteries.
1.23 Stow Used P-Trak Batteries.
NOTE
DustTrak Xµm Adapter will be used for DustTrak 10µm Adapter,
DustTrak 2.5µm Adapter or DustTrak 1µm Adapter.
2. DUSTTRAK DISASSEMBLY
2.1 Retrieve DustTrak.
2.2 √DustTrak power − Off
DustTrak 2.3 Disconnect DustTrak Xµm Adapter from DustTrak.
DustTrak Xµm Adapter ←|→ Inlet
2.4 Tmpry stow:
DustTrak
DustTrak Xµm Adapter
2.5 Retrieve DAFT Accessories Kit.
DAFT Accessories 2.6 Retrieve and stow DustTrak Xµm Adapter.
Kit
2.7 Tmpry stow DAFT Accessories Kit.
DustTrak 2.8 Retrieve DustTrak.
Remove (unscrew) and Tmpry stow DustTrak Battery Cover.
06May04 N013-3 DAFT/PB3-01-0677

2.013 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK RESTOW
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN013
NOTE
Move DustTrak battery pack wire to prevent obstruction of the
DustTrak Battery Pack.
2.9 Remove DustTrak battery pack from DustTrak (slight prying
motion).
2.10 Remove DustTrak Batteries (four).
Tmpry stow DustTrak Batteries (four).
NOTE
1. DustTrak battery pack wire should cover the DustTrak
battery pack after replacement of DustTrak battery pack.
2. DustTrak Battery Cover must be properly inserted into the
DustTrak for secure closure.
3. DustTrak Battery Cover closure is spring loaded. Slight
pressure is needed to secure DustTrak Battery Cover.
2.11 Replace DustTrak battery pack in DustTrak.
2.12 Retrieve and replace DustTrak Battery Cover taking care not to
pinch DustTrak battery pack wire.
2.13 Stow DustTrak.
2.14 If first DustTrak Batteries stowage,
Retrieve:
Fine Point Sharpie
4X4 Ziplock Bag
If not first DustTrak Batteries stowage,
Unstow Used DustTrak Batteries (P/N DAFT-0719).
Go to step 2.21.
2.15 Using Fine Point Sharpie, label 4X4 Ziplock Bag,
Used DustTrak Batteries P/N DAFT-0719.
Tmpry stow Fine Point Sharpie.
2.16 Retrieve Bar Code Kit.
Bar Code Kit 2.17 Remove IMS Bar Code Label.
Tmpry stow Bar Code Kit.
2.18 Retrieve 4X4 Ziplock Bag.
06May04 N013-4 DAFT/PB3-01-0677

2.013 DAFT P-TRAK AND DUSTTRAK RESTOW
MGUEEXPRSDAFTN013
2.19 Place IMS Bar Code Label on Used DustTrak Batteries.
2.20 Manually update IMS or Notify POIC with the new
DAFT B/C number (as required).
2.21 Retrieve DustTrak Batteries (four).
Place DustTrak Batteries (four) in Used DustTrak Batteries.
2.22 Stow:
Fine Point Sharpie
DAFT Accessories Kit
Used DustTrak Batteries
Bar Code Kit (as required)
Single Strap (as required)
Cable Straps (six) (as required)
RESTOW tools, parts, materials, as required, to original locations:
06May04 N013-5 DAFT/PB3-01-0677
